title: Continue authorized implementation after a checked milestone
goal: Proceed to the next authorized milestone after completing the current scope and required checks.
context: The delivery basis is accepted and additional implementation is authorized.
trigger: The current milestone work and checks reach their recorded completion point.
preconditions: The requested scope and relevant project authority are identifiable.

interaction.action: Records completed work, actual check results, remaining dependencies and blockers.
Identifies whether the next milestone is within authority and has satisfied dependencies.
Continues the eligible work or addresses the identified blocking condition.

expected_outcome: An eligible next milestone proceeds without reviewer assignment, milestone review record or approval status.

alternatives.condition: The request authorizes only the completed isolated slice.
alternatives.outcome: The result reports scoped progress and stops without assuming further authority.

failures.condition: A required check fails or a material safety, authority or architectural issue remains.
failures.outcome: Affected continuation is blocked and the responsible correction is identified.
Editing all planned files does not establish implementation completion.

sources.basis: User-selected requirement-first workflow and one mandatory whole-change Code Review gate. Proposed requirement analysis only; existing product contracts remain active until coordinated adoption. No new Function, AR, implementation or approval is inferred.

Document-based author assessment under the explicit Constitution exception confirms this Scenario as requirement-analysis knowledge. It is not independent review, executed product evidence or workflow activation.
